devdoc.details: The vendored V2 base provides the unchanged rawFulfillRandomWords callback ABI and an immutable sender check only; requests use the distinct v2.5 ABI with uint256 subscription IDs. Upstream migration changes randomness identity and requires a new adapter deployment.

requestEntropy(bytes32,bytes).notice: The subscription pays Chainlink directly; no per-request Ether is accepted here.

streamModuleCodeHash().notice: The module's own runtime code hash.

streamModuleDeploymentManifestHash().notice: Deployment manifest commitment recorded for this deployment.

streamModuleInterfaceId().notice: Primary ERC-165 interface ID the module serves.

streamModuleManifest().notice: Module manifest URI and content commitment.

streamModuleSchemaHash().notice: Schema commitment for the module's stored/served data shapes.

streamModuleSupersedes().notice: Immediate predecessor in the same module family, or the zero         address for a first-generation module.

streamModuleVersion().notice: Module version identifier within its family.

updateSubscription(uint256,bool).notice: Operational billing only; changing this never changes a committed randomness input.

userdoc.notice: Subscription-funded VRF v2.5 adapter. Every upstream result is stored before delivery.
